proposal_rules.title: Canonical Identity + Row Evidence Gate
proposal_rules.hypothesis: Reference-mismatch failures recur when agents derive rows from downstream records but do not include the canonical identity record used to bind an entity/person filter.
proposal_rules.change: Add a pre-`report_completion` rule for entity/person-filtered answers: first resolve the filter using the canonical identity source (CRM: relevant `contacts/*.json` manager/contact file), then gather matching result rows (for example `accounts/*.json`). Require `grounding_refs` to include both (1) the canonical identity source and (2) the row-source files backing returned outputs.
